summary.en-US: Professor ratings, schedule insights, and class availability notifications for USC students.

description.en-US:
USC Schedule Helper improves the USC class search and Web Registration experience. It adds professor ratings to class results, highlights schedule conflicts, shows unit totals, exports registered classes to an .ics calendar, and lets students request class availability notifications. Calendar export uses USC's published term and session dates, skips holidays and session breaks, and opens USC's official exporter if the required data cannot be validated.

The Final Exams button in CourseBin shows tentative exam times for registered and scheduled courses, with explanations when a time cannot be determined. Confirm exam times with your instructor. Final exams are not added to calendar exports.

Email notifications are free. Optional SMS notifications cost $1 per section per semester.

The extension runs on classes.usc.edu and webreg.usc.edu. Calendar files and final-exam lists are generated locally. Public date and holiday lookups from classes.usc.edu and www.usc.edu omit sign-in credentials; catalog requests contain course, term, or session identifiers. Optional access to arr.usc.edu lets the extension fetch the registrar's public final-exam schedule without sending sign-in credentials or your personal schedule. Without live access, it uses cached or bundled public exam data. The public exam cache is considered fresh for 24 hours; older entries remain available as a fallback until replaced, cleared, or the extension is removed. Notification requests send the email address, optional phone number, and selected class details that the user submits to usc.jonlu.ca. See the privacy policy at https://usc.jonlu.ca/privacy.

release_notes.en-US: Added Final Exams to CourseBin, showing tentative exam times for registered and scheduled courses from USC's published schedule. Optional access to arr.usc.edu enables live updates; cached or bundled public data is available without it. Exam lists stop with an explanation if the fetched CourseBin belongs to another term. Final exams are view-only and are not added to calendar exports. Fixed the Notify Me popup and calendar exports for TBA sections with an empty Days field.

version.approval_notes: Build instructions and calendar export/Final Exams test steps are in SOURCE_CODE_REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. No API keys, database credentials, or .env files are required. The archive includes both Prisma configurations and schemas needed by postinstall. Public pages under https://classes.usc.edu/term/ exercise ratings and notification UI. Calendar export and Final Exams require a USC-authenticated Web Registration session; the extension reads registered or scheduled courses locally. Required host permissions are https://classes.usc.edu/* and https://www.usc.edu/* for public calendar metadata. The new https://arr.usc.edu/* host permission is optional and is requested only after the user clicks Allow live updates, then approves access on a separate extension page. Registrar requests omit credentials and personal schedule information. Parsed public exam data and its fetch timestamp are stored locally by term, along with a permission grant timestamp. The cache is fresh for 24 hours; stale entries remain as a fallback until replaced, cleared, or the extension is removed. The cache does not contain the user's courses. If live/cached data is unavailable, an included registrar snapshot supplies the bundled schedule. Final exams are tentative, view-only, and excluded from .ics exports; mismatched CourseBin terms are rejected. The background accepts calendar and final-exam requests only from https://webreg.usc.edu. Invalid or unavailable calendar data opens USC's official calendar exporter without downloading a partial calendar. Email notifications are free; optional SMS notifications cost $1 per section per semester. The entered email address, optional phone number, and selected class department/section/semester are sent to https://usc.jonlu.ca only after the user clicks Submit in the notification form.
